requirements_summary: SentryCode builds an IDE copilot integrated into enterprise editor installs. Primary ask: deterministic and reproducible code completions across model versions and quantization settings. Must support: (1) pinning of exact model bundle (model weights sha, tokenizer version, quantization profile), (2) canary & gradual rollouts with percentage traffic routing, (3) eval gates that run canonical developer test-suite and pass-rate thresholds before promotion, (4) low-latency streaming (target ~<50ms avg per-token on typical completions), (5) audit logs for which model variant served each completion for debugging and compliance. Also require SDK hooks for cassette-style replay of inference to reproduce bugs in CI. Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for dedicated capacity for consistent p99 latency.
notes:
- Engineering wants a model bundle concept: immutable id that includes model hash + tokenizer + quant cfg.
- Quote from lead eng: "We need 1:1 reproducible outputs for regression tracking — if a snippet changed, we must be able to point at the exact model build and repro."
- POC plan: 2-week canary on Redwood hosted -> measure functional regression rate against our baseline test prompts (internal repo).
- Eval gates: run nightly runbook: unit tests + integration prompts + fuzzing prompts; gate is pass_rate >= 98% and no high-severity regressions.
- Rollout policy required: canary (5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%) with automatic rollback on metric regression. Need API to configure rollout windows and automated fallback to previous pinned version.
- Streaming: engineers expect chunked token streams and ability to cancel/rewind KV cache on re-rollouts.
- Observability: need token-level cost breakdown per route, and sample storage for failed prompts for offline analysis.
- Security: must keep PII out of logs, configurable retention, KMS for model keys.
- Contract asks: SLA for p99 on dedicated; option for VPC private control plane.
- Pricing: prefer predictable reserved capacity if p99 targets achieved.
- Quote from product manager: "If Redwood can guarantee reproducible pinned bundles + easy canary APIs, we can commit to dedicated capacity."
- Internal stakeholders: CTO (Alice Moran), Head of Platform (Diego Ramos), Lead ML Engineer (Rina Patel).
